I’m so proud to see how the $850,000 in community project funding that we secured for the Bright Futures Youth Homelessness Prevention project while I represented STL in Congress will be put to use!

Congratulations to Youth In Need on their newest location in Spanish Lake. Here, our youth will get the wraparound services they need to thrive.

posts.text:
When historic flooding devastated St. Louis in the summer of 2022, I worked tirelessly to ensure that our community got the disaster relief it so desperately needed.

Over a year later, our community is still struggling to recover from the May 2025 Tornado.

St. Louis deserves a Representative with the expertise to fight to secure recovery funding.

When I’m back in Congress, I’ll do exactly that so our neighborhoods can rebuild.

Thank you to Jessica, Carly, Sarah, and all who joined us at Flowers & Weeds in the Cherokee Street Business District for Chai with Cori!

I was so glad to meet with community members for an important conversation on universal healthcare, immigration justice, and how we’ll shape STL’s future.

And a special shout-out to our intern, Arpitha, for organizing this event!

posts.text:
Happy Juneteenth, St. Louis!

Today marks Freedom Day, and we’ll spend it celebrating the history of Black activists from STL and across the country whose tireless struggle for justice and equality paved the way for us.

But our movement isn't confined to history books. Until we have reparations, an end to institutionalized racism, and achieve liberation, our fight continues.

I’ll always center the needs of everyday people over large corporations.

Our community has long been the testing ground for projects that were forced on us, leaving our residents to suffer the consequences.

Our leaders must prioritize the health and well-being of the people they represent first, not the AI industry or MAGA megadonors.

Trump and his MAGA allies have made it clear that they intend to keep attacking our voting rights and our children's education.

The time is now to fight back.

I’m running for Congress because STL can’t wait any longer for a Representative who will fight to stop the MAGA agenda.
